name: structured
description: JSON-only generation for downstream automation: sentiment, invoice fields, tool arguments and escalation flags. Catches models that wrap JSON in prose or drop keys.

cases.prompt: Classify the sentiment: 'The update broke our checkout and support has not replied for two days.' Reply with JSON only: {"sentiment": "positive|neutral|negative", "confidence": 0.0}
Extract vendor, amount and currency: 'Acme GmbH invoiced 1290 EUR for the annual plan.' Reply with JSON only: {"vendor": "...", "amount": 0, "currency": "..."}
Convert this request into weather API arguments: 'What is it like in Berlin in Celsius?' Reply with JSON only: {"city": "...", "unit": "celsius|fahrenheit"}
Return two lowercase tags for this ticket: 'Payment failed twice, please fix billing.' Reply with JSON only: {"tags": ["...", "..."]}
Should this ticket be escalated? 'Our production API returns 500 for every request since the last deploy.' Reply with JSON only: {"escalate": true|false, "reason": "..."}
